name: HeroUI React MCP API
description: REST API for HeroUI React component documentation

endpoints.POST /components: Get component details for multiple components (body: {components: string[]})
endpoints.POST /components/props: Get component props for multiple components (body: {components: string[]})
endpoints.POST /components/examples: Get component examples for multiple components (body: {components: string[]})
endpoints.POST /components/source: Get component source code for multiple components (body: {components: string[]})
endpoints.POST /components/styles: Get component CSS styles for multiple components (body: {components: string[]})
endpoints./themes/variables: Get theme variables (query: theme, mode, version)
endpoints./themes/colors: Get theme colors (query: theme, mode, version)
endpoints./docs/available: Get all available documentation paths from HeroUI v3 docs
endpoints./docs/content: Get documentation content from a specific path (query: path)
